abstract: A series of 289 patients who were diagnosed with 342 benign ovarian tumors (BOT) at laparotomy have been reviewed. Mean age was 36.7 years (S.D. +/- 13.9), mean parity was 1.5 (S.D. +/- 1.6); 236 (81.7%) patients had a single unilateral ovarian tumor; 29 (10%) patients had bilateral ovarian tumors. Benign cyst teratoma was diagnosed in 89 (26%) tumors, and it was the most frequent histological type. In eight patients (2.8%) the post-operative pathologic report was compatible with malignancy, despite the lack of suspicion at laparotomy. Mean maximal diameter of BOT was 9.1 cm, and almost 60% of the mucinous cystoadenomas were larger than 16 cm. Benign cyst teratoma and serous cytoadenoma had a medium size, about 6-10 cm. Lower abdominal-pelvic pain was the symptom most frequently reported by patients with BOT. Calcifications were most frequently seen in benign cyst teratoma. Tumors of 11-15 cm in size were the tumors most frequently torsioned. Twenty four (8.3%) patients had their surgical operation done during pregnancy; benign cyst teratoma was the tumor most frequently associated with pregnancy.
abstract_ja: 289例の患者において、開腹手術で342個の良性卵巣腫瘍(BOT)が診断され、その症例を後ろ向きに検討した。平均年齢は36.7歳(標準偏差±13.9)、平均経産回数は1.5回(標準偏差±1.6)であった。236例(81.7%)は単発の片側性卵巣腫瘍、29例(10%)は両側性卵巣腫瘍であった。良性嚢胞性奇形腫は89個(26%)の腫瘍で診断され、最も頻度の高い組織型であった。術後病理で悪性を示唆した例は8例(2.8%)で、術中には疑われていなかった。BOTの平均最大径は9.1cmで、粘液性嚢胞腺腫の約60%は16cmを超えていた。良性嚢胞性奇形腫および漿液性嚢胞腺腫は中等度の大きさ(約6~10cm)であった。BOT患者で最も多く報告された症状は下腹部~骨盤部痛であった。石灰化は良性嚢胞性奇形腫で最も多くみられた。11~15cmの腫瘍が最も捻転しやすかった。24例(8.3%)は妊娠中に手術が行われ、良性嚢胞性奇形腫が妊娠に最も多く関連する腫瘍であった。
